common_initial_holdings: accepted fixed512 seed1 pretrade at December 2015 decision
descriptive_metric: net population variance utility; never used to rescue failed source-utility gate
exit_convention: inherit accepted remapping with no extra dropped-position liquidation cost

inference.method: paired circular stationary bootstrap, same month indices across all paths; basic Bonferroni intervals
inference.family_scope: two candidates times two controls times two evaluation periods; block lengths are mandatory sensitivity checks

gate.point_gains: strictly positive source utility versus both controls in both periods
gate.primary_inference: strictly positive adjusted lower bounds versus both controls for both block lengths
gate.passing_meaning: promising exploratory evidence eligible for a separately specified larger test

limitations: All outcome years have previously been exposed; this is exploratory, not fresh confirmation.
No direct comparable claim against the paper's 1981-2020 published 8.60% utility.
Bootstrap conditional on saved trained targets; no model re-estimation uncertainty.
Original source publication timestamps and revision vintages remain uncertified.
Convexity guarantees utility improvement over average component utilities only, not either control or future returns.
